verification_policy.item_requirement: Every accepted item must cite a source_id, exact article/section/page, source version or effective date, retrieved_at, and verified_at.

verification_policy.technical_version_policy: Use the current stable reference version at research time; version-sensitive questions must state the version explicitly in the stem.
